_provenance: Deliberate DRAFT version used to prove that an unpublished version is never evaluated. Adds a 2-hectare land ceiling that version 1 does not have.
name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)

conditions.label: The family must own cultivable land in the official land records
No family member may have paid income tax in the last assessment year
Retired government pensioners drawing 10,000 rupees a month or more are excluded
Landholding must not exceed 2 hectares (20,000 square metres)
